title: Political Science - Pre-Law Option
sourceText:
Biological Sciences [BSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Humanities [HUM]

POL S 101 [SSCI]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

ECONS 101 or ECONS 102

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG]

Physical Sciences [PSCI] with lab
To meet College of Arts and Sciences requirements, students must complete 1 additional lab credit of [BSCI] or [PSCI] for a total of 8 credits (2 labs).

POL S 102

Electives

Arts [ARTS]

CRM J 101 (recommended) or Elective

PHIL 201

POL S 103

ENGLISH 201 [WRTG], ENGLISH 301 [WRTG], or PHIL 200 [WRTG]

Equity and Justice [EQJS]

H D 205 [COMM] or COM 102 [COMM]

POL S 201

POL S 300

Complete Writing Portfolio

300-400-level POL S Elective
POL S Electives need to include an additional [M] course to fulfill University requirements.

Ethics and Law Course
Ethics and Law Course: Choose from B LAW 210, COM 415, CES 440, CRM J 320, 380, or 420, ENGLISH 112, or 364, HISTORY 410, and PHIL 360, 365, 370, 450, or 460.

POL S 402

Foreign Language, if necessary, or Electives

POL S 404 [M]

Diversity [DIVR]

300-400-level Electives

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

PHIL 470

Complete the School’s Exit Survey for Political Science majors

A student may be admitted to the Political Science - Pre-Law option upon making their intention known to the department.

30 credits in POL S are required.  15 of the 30 credits of POL S course work must be earned at WSU.
